generationPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: One final story still, landscape 1536x1024 pixels, for the fantasy game STARLIT-GUILD.
Primary request: Radically recompose the reference into a quiet, landscape-dominant painting: two companions seated shoulder-to-shoulder seen ENTIRELY FROM BEHIND, looking straight ahead into the depth of the landscape at a modest tower whose magic is only faintly reawakening.
Input images: Reference 1 is ONLY a clothing-identity reference: Aria has long blonde hair, green gold-trimmed hooded cloak and white feather; Leon has brown hair, red scarf/cape and a steel shoulder piece. Explicitly DO NOT copy its portrait composition, visible faces, gold light, polished anime rendering or directional gaze. Reference 2 is ONLY a reference for the modest cylindrical stone road-beacon with a small roofed upper chamber and the rural hill/road geography. Break with the prior composition and rendering style.
Scene: Blue/indigo twilight, rural hillside working area following overgrown moss removal. Exactly two young adult companions sit comfortably beside one another on a low stone ledge, shoulders touching lightly, relaxed and quietly satisfied. Their backs face the viewer squarely and their heads both face straight ahead into the distance toward the tower. Back of both heads only: NO face, NO cheek, NO nose, NO eye, NO side profile. Neither character turns toward the viewer or the right edge. A small basket of removed moss and wooden scraper rest beside the ledge.
Composition: Wide scenic landscape dominates about 80 percent of the painting. The seated pair is SMALL, lower center, each only about 20 to 25 percent of image height including seated body. Aria left and Leon right. Clearly seated bent legs/boots visible below the stone ledge. Their bodies, shoulders and back-of-head direction aim toward the tower straight ahead beyond them near the upper center, slightly right of center. Complete modest tower with roof tip in frame. Broad atmospheric hills, winding unlit country path and distant blue village. Quiet intimate closeness through silhouettes, never a character portrait.
Visual idiom: Evocative hand-painted gouache and oil fantasy landscape. Loose visible brushwork, broken color, tactile matte paint, soft irregular edges, atmospheric perspective and elegant restrained shapes. Painterly silhouettes with clothing recognition only. Avoid detailed anime portrait illustration, polished digital lineart, glossy airbrush and photographic sharpness.
Lighting: The tower's upper chamber contains a VERY FAINT muted lavender/violet magical glow, only just reawakening. Low luminance, translucent dim purple inside the chamber, tiny localized haze immediately around the glass. The chamber should remain purple rather than white and should NOT become the brightest glaring object. No golden lantern, no yellow or orange flame, no bright white core, no light beam, no rays, no strong bloom, no glowing road, no illuminated path, no light spill on hills or characters. All terrain and figures visible through remaining cool twilight and ambient moonlight only. Deep indigo, slate blue, muted forest green, subdued red and lavender palette.
Mood: A small earned victory after work, a breath taken together, scenic stillness and affection without a confession.
Constraints: Exactly two characters, both seated together, complete back view, no faces or profiles, no looking right, no embracing, no combat, no extra characters, no huge castle, no giant tower, no text, captions, logos or watermarks.
editPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Final fantasy story illustration, retain 1536x1024 landscape.
Edit target: The provided twilight gouache landscape with two seated companions seen entirely from behind.
Change only these two linked compositional/light details, keeping all the successful existing scenic design, loose painted brush texture, blue/indigo twilight, modest cylindrical tower, and both characters' exact clothes and complete back-facing seated poses:
1. Make the seated pair smaller in the landscape. Together they remain shoulder-to-shoulder at LOWER CENTER on a low stone ledge, but each seated figure occupies ONLY 23 percent of full image height, instead of the current roughly 35 percent. Their bottoms sit near y=820 pixels and their heads near y=590 pixels on the 1024-pixel canvas. Both entirely seen from behind, facing straight into the distance at the tower, no face or profile whatsoever. Preserve relaxed seated bent legs, recognizable blonde/green/white-feather Aria silhouette and brown/red/steel Leon silhouette. Let the scenic hills occupy more area above and around them.
2. Dramatically DIM the tiny tower chamber. Replace its existing light and ALL outgoing light streaks with a faint, translucent, muted lavender violet tint only INSIDE the small glass upper chamber. The dim violet is only just visible, like a fading ember with no white component. Absolutely NO white core, NO bright bulb, NO star shape, NO horizontal streak, NO radial ray, NO outward light streaks in any direction, NO exterior glow or bloom, NO halo. The violet patch is subtle, desaturated and low brightness, about as bright as the surrounding twilight clouds, not a glaring spotlight. The glass framing remains legible over it. The road, hills and people remain lit ONLY by the existing cool ambient dusk, never by the tower.
Preserve composition broadly, tower and roof fully in frame upper center-right, village, winding unlit path, basket and scraper, hand-painted broken color. No new subjects, no text, no watermark.
revisionReason: The first recomposed draft achieved seated back-facing characters and painterly landscape, but characters occupied about 35% of image height and the tower retained bright light streaks and a bright core. A single targeted built-in edit reduced character scale and removed the rays and strong light.

findings.restrictions: No visible faces or profiles, no embrace, no combat, no giant beam, no extra character, no text or watermark.

hoodCorrection.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Correct a small garment construction error in this exact finished 1536x1024 fantasy story painting.
Edit target: The supplied landscape image. This is a strictly localized edit, not a scene regeneration.
Change ONLY the green hood, cloak neck transition and adjacent blonde hair of Aria, the small seated figure to the left of the red-cloaked man, at the lower center.
Problem to correct: Her hood currently looks like an independent green hat perched on top of hair, because a full curtain of blonde hair interrupts the join between its lower back edge and her cloak.
Required correction: Make this one anatomically believable HOODED CLOAK made from a single connected garment. The green hood is sewn continuously onto the green cloak. Paint an uninterrupted broad green cloth connection running from the back of her head down the nape, over both shoulders and into her upper back. Show continuous fabric folds and a subtle believable hood-to-cloak seam. The lower rear edge of the hood MUST merge into the neck/shoulder cloth, not form a floating separate hat rim. Remove the blonde hair curtain crossing the BACK BASE of the hood. Instead, blonde hair emerges only through the FRONT and SIDE face opening of the hood (hidden or mostly hidden from this rear camera angle) and drapes naturally down the outer left side and a small amount at the other side, leaving the central back-of-head-to-back green cloth connection clearly visible. Long blonde identity, white feather on the hood and delicate gold trim remain. Hood remains worn on head.
Invariant preservation: Keep exact seated pose, complete rear view with NO face or profile, shoulder-to-shoulder closeness, body and head size, Aria position, Leon completely unchanged, stone seat, basket, road, hills, village, sky, tower and its extremely faint violet window unchanged. Preserve the loose visible painterly brush texture and original color grading. No rays, no brighter tower glow, no new light. Do not move, crop, zoom, rescale or redesign any part of the scene. No added text or watermark. Output the same full 1536x1024 composition with only this small clothing/hair correction.

visualQA.hoodConnection: Clearly continuous green cloth now runs from rear hood through neck into broad shoulder/back cloak. The previous full blonde hair curtain dividing hood and cloak is removed. Natural folds reinforce the fabric connection.
visualQA.hair: Blonde hair now falls mainly at the outer left side from the hood opening; no hair crosses the central rear hood base. White feather and gold trim preserved.
